_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for textures. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Recommending BC3/DXT5 for Fallout 4 normal (_n) and specular (_s) maps, e.g. "BC3 is the best DXT5 setting for Fallout 4" in NVIDIA Texture Tools Exporter.
patterns.correction: Use BC5 (two-channel) for _n normal and _s specular maps. Both maps only use red and green; BC5 stores exactly those two channels at full precision for the same file size as BC3 (8 bits per pixel), while BC3 squeezes them into a 5/6-bit colour block and wastes its alpha. BC7 is a good choice for _d diffuse. BC3 normals/speculars still load in game, so existing ones aren't broken, just lower quality.
